facts.fact: Miri 用平掌敲 Leah 的颅底，把她走神的念头称作「沉没的念头」
facts.anchor: Miri used to call these my sunken thoughts, tapping on the base of my skull with the flat of her hand when I grew quiet

facts.fact: Leah 抓住 Miri 的手掌留在原处，又把她的另一只手按在自己太阳穴上
facts.anchor: I would often catch her palm and keep it there, take her other hand and hold it to my temple

facts.fact: 失去联系前二十分钟，Jelka 对 Leah 说自己闻到肉味
facts.anchor: Twenty minutes before we lost contact, Jelka told me she thought she smelled meat

facts.fact: Matteo 让 Jelka 嫌味道就捏住自己的鼻子
facts.anchor: he told her to hold her nose if she was so bothered

facts.fact: 通讯面板的杂音中断后再没恢复，与地面的联系首先断掉
facts.anchor: At first it was only the comms panel, the crackle of contact from the surface cutting out and not returning.

facts.fact: Matteo 皱眉，让 Leah 去试着找信号，他自己处理主控制台
facts.anchor: I remember Matteo frowned and asked me to try to find a signal while he dealt with the main controls.

facts.fact: Leah 按住发射键，对着无线电把无意义的话念了一遍又一遍
facts.anchor: I held down the transmission button and chanted nonsense into the radio

facts.fact: 十分钟后整条艇的系统离线
facts.anchor: Ten minutes later, when the craft’s whole system went offline

relations.anchor: take her other hand and hold it to my temple
relations.kind: 亲密/身体接触的习惯：Miri 敲她颅底，她把 Miri 的手按在太阳穴上，像交出「把头护住」的责任

relations.anchor: and I didn’t say anything to back her up
relations.kind: 同艇同伴：Jelka 报告闻到肉味，Matteo 驳回时 Leah 没有出声替她作证

relations.anchor: When Jelka repeated her claim to Matteo he told her to hold her nose
relations.kind: 指挥者与被指挥者：Jelka 再次向 Matteo 提同一件事，被他不耐烦地打发

relations.anchor: asked me to try to find a signal while he dealt with the main controls
relations.kind: 艇内指挥关系：Matteo 指派 Leah 找信号，自己守主控制台
